trophies.name: Threshold
trophies.detail: Cross the broken bridge without completely rebuilding it.

trophies.name: Explore
trophies.detail: Discover all cloth creatures in the desert.

trophies.name: Adventure
trophies.detail: Pass through 15 gates while surfing through the sunken city.

trophies.name: Trials
trophies.detail: Sneak through the underground passage without tearing your scarf.

trophies.name: Ancestors
trophies.detail: Find a mysterious creature hidden in the temple.

trophies.name: Crossing
trophies.detail: Reach the summit with a companion and return to the beginning.

trophies.name: Rebirth
trophies.detail: Finish the game and return to the beginning.

trophies.name: Companion
trophies.detail: Finish the game with the same partner for the majority of the journey and return to the beginning.

trophies.name: Reflection
trophies.detail: Sit and meditate with another player for more than 20 seconds.

trophies.name: Return
trophies.detail: Start the journey again after a week long break.

trophies.name: Transcendence
trophies.detail: Collect all unique glowing symbols across one or more journeys.
